headline: DENISON MINES FLIPS TO FULL-SCALE CONSTRUCTION AT PHOENIX ISR — Freeze Wall Phase 1 Begun; $600M Build, First Uranium by Mid-2028 (TSX: DML / NYSE: DNN)
snippet: Denison Mines Corp. (TSX: DML / NYSE: DNN) announced July 28 that the Phoenix In-Situ Recovery uranium mine in Saskatchewan's Athabasca Basin has formally transitioned from site preparation to full-scale construction, with installation of the perimeter freeze wall for Phase 1 now underway. Site clearing, civil works, and a nearly 400-person construction camp have been established since March 2026; concrete work on the substation and main process plant foundations begins in August, supported by a mobilized on-site batch plant. Total initial capital is approximately $600 million over a roughly two-year build — with first uranium production targeted for mid-2028, Denison's Phoenix project advances on a collision course with what many analysts view as a tighter-than-expected global uranium supply window in 2028–2030.

headline: WESTHAVEN'S SHOVELNOSE INFILL LOCKS IN 27.51m @ 14.47 g/t Au — Single Hole Hits 0.52m @ 200 g/t Au, Best Assay Yet; South Zone Continuity Confirmed (TSXV: WVG)
snippet: Westhaven Gold Corp. (TSXV: WVG) published the fourth batch of results July 28 from its 35,000-metre resource infill program at the South Zone deposit on the Shovelnose Gold Property in southern British Columbia, with hole SNR26-99 returning 27.51 metres at 14.47 g/t gold and 52.3 g/t silver. SNR26-113 produced 0.52 metres at 200.0 g/t gold and 141 g/t silver — the highest single assay recorded in the entire infill campaign to date — confirming exceptional-grade veins within a broader bulk-tonnage envelope. Consistent intercepts across four batches de-risk the upcoming resource update, the first quantitative measure of the South Zone's scale.

headline: SILVER POPS TO $59.43 BUT GOLD MINERS BLEED — Equinox -35%, Gold Fields -26% YTD; $228B Q2 Market Cap Evaporated; Divergence Hits Widest in Years Pre-FOMC
snippet: Silver surged intraday to $59.43 on July 28 — its biggest single-session gain in weeks — briefly compressing the gold-silver ratio to 68.9:1 before retreating as the dollar firmed ahead of Wednesday's FOMC decision, with gold settling around $4,021. The stock paradox is stark: despite gold holding above $4,000, major mining shares are deep in YTD drawdowns (Equinox -35%, Gold Fields -26%, Alamos -26%, Hecla -25%, Barrick -16%, Agnico -14%), and the sector's 50 largest miners shed $228 billion in Q2 market cap. With interest-rate swaps still pricing a one-in-three chance of a hike Wednesday, resolution of Fed uncertainty may be the catalyst that finally closes this historically wide valuation gap.

headline: KITCO: WEDNESDAY IS BINARY — $4,200 SPIKE OR $3,800 TEST HINGES ON WARSH PRESSER; $4,000 IS THE LAST LINE OF TECHNICAL DEFENSE
snippet: A Kitco technical analysis published July 28 frames the upcoming FOMC as a clean binary for gold: a confirmed break above the near-term downward trendline opens a short-term path to $4,200, while a failure of the $4,000 psychological and technical support risks an accelerated move toward $3,800. Silver bears hold the near-term advantage as long as prices remain below the $58.53–$59.44 trader-reaction zone — and how Chair Warsh frames the committee's forward rate path, not just Wednesday's vote outcome, is identified as the decisive variable. The author argues this is one of the cleanest technical setups of the year: the next 48 hours will likely define gold's direction for the rest of Q3.

headline: VR RESOURCES DCIP CONFIRMS IP + CONDUCTIVITY ANOMALIES AT COPPER QUEEN — Alkalic Porphyry Drill Target Vectored to 400m Depth in Nevada (TSXV: VRR)
snippet: VR Resources Ltd. (TSXV: VRR) released final 3D-inversion results July 28 from a DCIP geophysical survey at the Copper Queen target on its Bonita porphyry copper-gold project in northwestern Nevada, revealing an IP chargeability anomaly on the south flank and a conductivity anomaly on the east flank of Copper Queen hill — both consistent with sub-surface sulphide mineralisation. The model encompasses approximately 187,000 resistivity data points and 135,500 IP data points modelled to approximately 400 metres depth, providing a precise drill vector for testing a potential alkalic copper-gold porphyry stock beneath a hill that already hosts anomalous surface copper-gold geochemistry.

headline: DLP RESOURCES ESPERANZA PERU: 550 g/t Ag AND 4.548% Cu IN SURFACE ROCKS — Two New Target Domains Delineated; Maiden 3,000m Drill Program Advancing to Q3 (TSXV: DLP)
snippet: DLP Resources Inc. (TSXV: DLP) reported July 28 results from 94 additional surface rock chip samples at the Esperanza copper-gold-molybdenum Project in southern Peru, topped by 550 g/t silver and 4.548% copper — the highest silver result recorded on the property to date. Two new priority target areas were defined: the Esperanza East Domain (a 1 km × 1 km target 3.7 km east-southeast of the main target) and the Northeast Vein Corridor (multiple polymetallic veins 6.5 km northeast), with 21 of 55 select samples exceeding 1% copper across all domains. Permitting for a maiden 3,000-metre diamond drill program is advancing for a Q3 2026 start, the first drill test of a system that keeps growing with each field season.

headline: HYCROFT Q2 2026: $220.5M CASH, ZERO DEBT AT A $10B NPV PROJECT — Accelerating High-Grade Silver Drilling at Brimstone & Vortex; Russell 3000 Added (NASDAQ: HYMC)
snippet: Hycroft Mining Holding Corporation (Nasdaq: HYMC) reported Q2 2026 results July 28 with $220.5 million in unrestricted cash and a completely debt-free balance sheet — a rare funding position for a company holding a $10-billion post-tax NPV project with a 51-year mine life in Nevada. The company was added to the Russell 3000 Index effective June 29, maintained a zero-lost-time safety record across 1.4 million-plus work hours, and plans to accelerate drilling with additional core rigs at the Brimstone and Vortex high-grade silver systems, which already host a 90.2-million-ounce M&I silver resource established after just 14 months — both systems remain open at depth and in all lateral directions.

headline: GOLD MINERS' NEAR-RECORD Q2 EARNINGS COLLIDE WITH HISTORIC STOCK DISCOUNTS — GDX Top 25 Unit Profits +50% YoY While Shares Trade at Lowest Multiples in Years
snippet: Adam Hamilton's GoldSeek analysis argues that the GDX top 25 gold miners are delivering their second-best quarterly results ever — with implied unit profits projected roughly 50% higher year-over-year as Q2 2026 gold prices averaged well above $4,000 — yet gold mining stocks are simultaneously near multi-year valuation lows relative to the metal. The piece identifies the disconnect as exceptional: fundamental earnings power has rarely been this strong while price-to-cash-flow multiples have rarely been this compressed. With Newmont posting a $2.2-billion record free cash flow and major producers reaffirming guidance, Hamilton contends the market's fixation on FOMC rate risk has created the best entry point in the current gold cycle for investors willing to hold through the catalyst.
